edit.text: Skye warns Mike Peterson about S.H.I.E.L.D. and offers to help him, but he kidnaps her to erase his records until Coulson's team subdues him.
edit.whoA: A Centipede subject Skye tries to help, who kidnaps her.
edit.whoB: A hacker who offers to help Mike, then is kidnapped by him.

edit.text: Mike Peterson knocks May out while the Centipede serum is making him unstable.
edit.whoA: A Centipede subject who knocks May out.
edit.whoB: An agent Mike knocks out while unstable.

edit.text: Phil Coulson sends Bobbi Morse undercover inside Hydra to watch over Jemma Simmons, then welcomes her onto his team.
edit.whoA: The director who sent Bobbi into Hydra and welcomes her onto his team.
edit.whoB: Coulson's agent, sent into Hydra to watch over Simmons.

edit.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#10
edit.text: Trip helps guard Raina from Daniel Whitehall in Vancouver. He then follows Skye and Raina into the sealed Kree temple and dies trying to stop the Diviner from transforming them.
Hive takes control of Daisy Johnson's mind and turns her against S.H.I.E.L.D.
edit.whoA: The Inhuman who takes control of Daisy's mind.

edit.text: Jeffrey Mace is the new Director of S.H.I.E.L.D., and Fitz works in his lab.
edit.whoB: A S.H.I.E.L.D. engineer in Mace's lab.

edit.text: Aida, Holden Radcliffe's android, works as his assistant at S.H.I.E.L.D., where Phil Coulson is an agent.
edit.whoA: An agent at the S.H.I.E.L.D. base where Aida assists Radcliffe.

edit.text: The gate Aida and Holden Radcliffe build helps bring Robbie back from between dimensions.
edit.whoB: The android whose gate helps bring Robbie back.

edit.text: Geoffrey is Alex's father and a leader of PRIDE, and Alex learns his parents help sacrifice children.
edit.whoB: Geoffrey's son, who learns what PRIDE does.

edit.text: Catherine is Alex's mother, and she hides her part in PRIDE's killings from him.
edit.whoA: Catherine's son, who uncovers PRIDE's ritual.
edit.whoB: Alex's mother, who hides her part in PRIDE's killings.

edit.text: Catherine and Geoffrey are married partners in PRIDE.
edit.whoB: Geoffrey's wife and partner in PRIDE.

edit.text: Janet is Chase's mother, and she protects him from Victor.
Evita is Tyrone's classmate, and she invites him to a party.
edit.whoA: Tyrone's classmate, who invites him to a party.
edit.whoB: Evita's classmate, whom she invites to a party.

edit.text: Angie Kim and Brett Mahoney are NYPD colleagues who both turn against Fisk's Anti-Vigilante Task Force. They stand together in the resistance outside the State Supreme Court.
James Wesley handles Wilson Fisk's dealings with Nobu Yoshioka, who represents the Yakuza in Fisk's criminal alliance.
edit.whoA: The Yakuza's man in Fisk's alliance.
The Yakuza's man in Fisk's alliance, whose share Wesley never quite understands.

edit.text: Nobu, a leader of the Yakuza, nearly kills Matt in their first fight, and Matt barely survives by setting him on fire.
edit.whoA: A Yakuza leader who nearly kills him, until Matt sets him on fire.

edit.text: Stick is the blind warrior who trains young Matt after the accident, and he returns years later to pull Matt into his fight against the Black Sky.
Nobu represents the Yakuza in Fisk's alliance and reminds Fisk of the promises he made to the people Nobu represents.
edit.whoA: The crime boss whose alliance Nobu sits in for the Yakuza.
edit.whoB: The Yakuza's man in Fisk's alliance.

edit.text: Nobu pushes Fisk to clear the tenants from a building his people want. Fisk lures Daredevil into a fight with Nobu that ends with Nobu burning.
edit.whoB: The Yakuza's man in Fisk's alliance, pushing him to clear a building.

edit.text: After Shaw dies, Erik breaks Emma out of prison, and she joins his mutants.
edit.whoA: Freed by Erik to join his mutants.

edit.text: After Shaw dies, Azazel joins Erik's mutants.
After Shaw dies, Riptide joins Erik's mutants.
After Shaw dies, Angel joins Erik's mutants.

edit.whoB: A rogue Malick heir Sibyl arms with the Time Stream.
A rogue Malick heir Sibyl keeps on a short leash.

edit.title: Jessica Jones S2#7
edit.text: Jessica is Alisa's daughter. She learns that her mother survived the car crash that killed her family, because IGH secretly saved and changed her.
edit.whoA: Alisa's daughter, who learns Alisa survived the crash.
